item.title: 'Starting Point' For Artemi Panarin Trade Revealed

item.title: NHL Rumors: Senators Getting Trade Calls On Top-Pairing Defenseman
item.description: The Ottawa Senators are getting plenty of trade market attention, and one name Bruce Garrioch of the Ottawa Citizen flagged as a real monitor is right-shot defenceman Artem Zub. Garrioch reported that teams have been talking to Ottawa about Zub, who has one more year left at a $4.6 million cap hit and does not have trade protection, which makes him a easier conversation piece if the Senators decide to reshuffle their blue line.
